stars.author: David Nash / Astronexus, HYG Database v4.1
stars.changes: Excluded the Sun and stars fainter than visual magnitude 5.5; retained ID/name, magnitude, J2000 Cartesian position/velocity and colour index; sorted by HYG ID.
stars.policy: Mean astrometric J2000-aligned directions propagated linearly using catalogue Cartesian pc/year velocities and Julian years since J2000. No annual aberration, annual parallax, light deflection, observer parallax, extinction, or variable-star brightness modelling. Unknown radial velocities retain the catalogue zero assumption. Catalogue star sizes/brightness are visual encodings, not photometry or physical sizes.

constellations.author: Pierre Barbier, constellation boundary compilation, 2012–2022; from Eugène Delporte (1930)
constellations.changes: Parsed the author-provided interpolated J2000 boundary vertices and label centres; converted RA hours to degrees; retained constellation order including the two Serpens regions.
constellations.policy: Author-transformed B1875 Delporte meridian/parallel boundaries to J2000 using Explanatory Supplement pp103–104 and SOFA Besselian/Julian epoch conversion. Boundary samples follow original small-circle parallels before precession; never replace them with one endpoint-to-endpoint great-circle arc. Fixed J2000 sky regions do not undergo stellar proper motion.
